name: Schloss Camping Aschach
beschreibung: The Schloss Camping Aschach is located in the municipality of Volders in the Inntal, about 15 kilometers east of Innsbruck. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and tents on level, partly shaded grounds near the historic Schloss Aschach. The facilities include sanitary facilities, an electricity connection at the pitches, and washing machine use for guests. The surroundings are characterized by the mountains of Tirol, while the Inntal offers diverse opportunities for hiking and cycling tours. Nearby are several ski areas that can be reached by car in winter. The location is suitable as a starting point for excursions to Innsbruck and into the surrounding valleys. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and nestled in a close-to-nature landscape with views of the surrounding mountain ranges.
